packet.serialization: Original inline JSON text followed by a single LF, UTF-8

claims.criterion: 120 relabeled native edges equal GraphSym entry 6. The relabeled G15 quotient satisfies Q = MMᵀ = A³+2A²+2I.

claims.inputs: chosen launch, signed actions, native tensors, quotient
claims.criterion: Rebuild the rational launch and first-zero held/free update, then compare the signed fields and each native dart at all ten rows.

claims.inputs: B1, B2, regenerated q and v, rational G/Gden and C/Cden
claims.criterion: Generate normalized endpoint rho and exact Green span; check within-fibre null and site-26 pacing samples. Probe tolerance 1e-14 absolute.
Compare all ten guard products and both retained/cleared interventions on each launch route.

claims.inputs: incoming dart, signed face state, W turn tensor
claims.criterion: Select the downward crossing among the eligible outgoing guards and compare all ten successors.
Check four lifts per slot and recover the 60 sites from (slot, index in sorted fibre).

claims.inputs: integer X and Z, charge projector and encoder
claims.criterion: Check commutator norm 2 and vanishing one-wing charge contractions.

claims.evidence: exact pair computation and independent projector check
claims.inputs: signed four-flux state, collective switch and analyzer axes
claims.criterion: Compare 40 E fractions and 10 scores; prove the three-chamber identity and independently check 40 joint tables.

claims.inputs: K=3,F=3 source, both stations, frozen receiver and flight data
claims.criterion: Compare all probabilities, correlations, S and marginal changes for three stored preparations with absolute tolerance 1e-11.

claims.inputs: actual UI cutoff and mixer, controlled RGB ramps and step edge
claims.criterion: Test six cutoff positions across 768 pixels each per available backend, five hue/gain controls, and the 35% direct / 65% blurred step profile. At 100% only exact display white passes.

boundaries: The specified preparation, calibration and analyzer axes select this experiment; an unlabeled adjacency list permits many choices.
The sampled pair outcomes are drawn from joint tables. Experimental detector outcomes, physical separation, and a loophole-controlled Bell test are outside this replay.
The optics receipt identifies the measured browser backends. The blur is a display-space approximation.
